entries.description: Stores synchronized fsm administration data for the netsuite account, including the installed product version and account-level feature settings.
entries.label: Field Service Account

entries.description: Stores the synchronized account-level setting that controls oracle maps availability in fsm.
entries.label: Oracle Maps
notes: Contains a comma-separated array of user selectors, not a checkbox. A nonempty value alone does not establish availability for a user.

entries.description: Stores the fsm suiteapp version recorded for the netsuite account and used to assess upgrade-related processing.
entries.label: Version

entries.description: Stores account-specific Field Service Management configuration that merges with the core configuration at runtime. Contains javascript object notation settings that override or extend default product behavior for account-specific operations.
entries.label: Field Service Configuration
notes: Effective configuration starts with defaults and merges the cleaned bodies of active configuration records.

entries.description: Records Field Service Management application errors for administration and support review. Stores the error message, occurrence date and time, associated user and role, and recovery status; unresolved blocking errors can prevent affected scheduled processing from continuing.
entries.label: Field Service Error
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Stores the message captured for a Field Service Management application error. Contains descriptive text that identifies the failure and provides information for error investigation and resolution.
entries.label: Message
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Indicates whether an application error is marked as recovered. Stores a recovery status that distinguishes resolved errors from unresolved errors for error tracking and review.
entries.label: Recovered
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Stores when Field Service Management recorded an application error. Contains a date-and-time value used to place the error in sequence and support investigation and resolution.
entries.label: Date
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Identifies the account identity associated with an application error when available. Stores a reference or identifier that provides execution context for error investigation and resolution.
entries.label: User
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Identifies the netsuite role active when Field Service Management recorded an application error. Stores a role record reference that provides access and execution context for investigation.
entries.label: Role
notes: Error reporting omits negative internal user identities and validates non-administrator roles. Marking an error recovered does not repair its cause.

entries.description: Stores read-only time zones supplied with Field Service Management and associated with supported records. Contains time zone names and identifier values used to manage and convert date-and-time information.
entries.label: Field Service Time Zone

entries.description: Stores the olson identifier associated with the time zone record. Contains an identifier value used in saved-search formulas to convert dates and times between supported time zones.
entries.label: Olson

entries.description: Stores the difference between the time zone and coordinated universal time. Contains a positive or negative offset value used to interpret dates and times associated with the time zone.
entries.label: Offset

entries.description: Stores the abbreviated name associated with the time zone. Contains a short alphabetic code used to identify the time zone in compact date, time, or scheduling information.
entries.label: Abbreviation

entries.description: Defines the schedule used to generate recurring field service cases or crm tasks. Stores the frequency, interval, repetition pattern, start date, ending rule, source recurrence, and primary record type that control instance generation.
entries.label: Field Service Recurrence

entries.description: Specifies how often recurring cases or tasks repeat within a generated series. Contains a recurrence frequency value identifying a daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly generation pattern.
entries.label: Type

entries.description: Stores the number of recurrence units between generated instances in the recurring series. Contains a positive whole number interval interpreted according to the selected recurrence frequency.
entries.label: Interval

entries.description: Specifies the month in which yearly recurrence instances are generated. Contains a month selection used with the yearly recurrence frequency and related monthly pattern settings.
entries.label: Month

entries.description: Specifies how monthly or yearly recurrence instances are positioned within a month. Contains a pattern value distinguishing a numbered calendar day from an ordinal weekday.
entries.label: Month Pattern

entries.description: Specifies the calendar day on which monthly or yearly recurrence instances begin. Contains a day-of-month number used when the recurrence follows a numbered calendar-day pattern.
entries.label: Day of Month

entries.description: Specifies the weekday used for weekly recurrence or an ordinal monthly or yearly pattern. Contains one or more weekday selections that determine when instances begin
entries.label: Day of Week

entries.description: Stores the date from which the recurrence begins generating instances based on the primary case or task. Contains a calendar date that establishes the start of the recurring series.
entries.label: Start Date

entries.description: Specifies how generation ends for the recurring record series. Contains a selection indicating no fixed end, a maximum instance count, or a final generation date.
entries.label: End Type

entries.description: Stores the final date for generating recurrence instances when the selected ending method uses a date. Contains a calendar date that limits the recurring series
entries.label: End Date

entries.description: Stores the maximum number of instances generated when the selected ending method uses a count. Contains a positive whole number that limits the recurring series.
entries.label: End Count

entries.description: Identifies the source recurrence from which the current recurrence was copied. Contains a reference to the originating recurrence record for tracking the copied schedule relationship.
entries.label: Created From

entries.description: Identifies the netsuite record type generated by the recurrence. Contains a type value that distinguishes whether the primary recurring record and resulting instances are cases or crm tasks.
entries.label: Primary Type

entries.description: Records installation work performed for a field service asset and links the result, notes, image, and completing employee to the related project, case, task, or project task.
entries.label: Field Service Install

entries.description: Identifies the field service asset associated with an installation record. Stores an asset record reference so installation details remain associated with the asset involved, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the project associated with an installation record. Stores a project record reference so installation details remain associated with the relevant project, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Project

entries.description: Links the installation result to the NetSuite support case representing the customer service request. This relationship is distinct from the Project and Project Task fields on the installation result.
entries.label: Case

entries.description: Identifies the Customer Relationship Management task associated with an installation record. Stores a task record reference so installation details remain associated with the relevant task.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Identifies the project task associated with an installation record. Stores a project task reference so installation details remain associated with the relevant project task, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Project Task

entries.description: Identifies the employee recorded as completing an installation. Stores an employee record reference to preserve responsibility information for the completed installation entry, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Completed By

entries.description: Records the completion status of an installation entry. Stores a list selection of complete, incomplete, or not applicable for tracking the installation result, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Outcome

entries.description: Stores written details about an installation entry. Contains free-form text for recording observations, conditions, explanations, or other information relevant to the installation, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Notes

entries.description: Stores visual documentation associated with an installation entry. Contains an image recorded with the installation to preserve visual information about the completed work, supporting installation tracking and reporting.
entries.label: Image

entries.description: Records maintenance work performed for a field service asset and links the outcome, notes, image, and completing employee to the related project, case, task, or project task.
entries.label: Field Service Maintenance

entries.description: Stores the field service asset associated with the field service maintenance record. Contains a selected asset record value identifying the asset recorded for the maintenance entry.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the netsuite project associated with a maintenance record. Stores a project record reference that relates the maintenance result to the broader project under which the field work was performed.
entries.label: Project

entries.description: Links the maintenance result to the NetSuite support case representing the customer service request. This relationship is distinct from the Project and Project Task fields on the maintenance result.
entries.label: Case

entries.description: Stores the crm task associated with the field service maintenance record. Contains a selected task record value identifying the task recorded for the maintenance entry.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Stores the project task associated with the field service maintenance record. Contains a selected project task record value identifying the project task recorded for the maintenance entry.
entries.label: Project Task

entries.description: Identifies the employee recorded as completing the maintenance work. Stores an employee record reference that attributes the maintenance result to the technician or other employee responsible for completion.
entries.label: Completed By

entries.description: Records the result of maintenance work. Contains a list selection of pass, fail, or not applicable that summarizes the maintenance result separately from notes, images, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Outcome

entries.description: Stores free-form text describing the maintenance work and its recorded result. Captures service details that are not represented by the structured outcome, employee, asset, or related project, case, task, and project-task references.
entries.label: Notes

entries.description: Stores an image reference documenting the maintenance work. Associates visual evidence with the maintenance result while keeping the image distinct from written notes, structured outcome values, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Image

entries.description: Records repair work performed for a field service asset and links the outcome, notes, image, and completing employee to the related project, case, task, or project task.
entries.label: Field Service Repair

entries.description: Stores the field service asset associated with the field service repair record. Contains a selected asset record value identifying the asset recorded for the repair.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the netsuite project associated with a repair record. Stores a project record reference that relates the repair result to the broader project under which the field work was performed.
entries.label: Project

entries.description: Links the repair result to the NetSuite support case representing the customer service request. This relationship is distinct from the Project and Project Task fields on the repair result.
entries.label: Case

entries.description: Identifies the crm task associated with a repair record. Stores a task record reference that relates the repair result to the scheduled field service work completed by the technician.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Stores the project task associated with the field service repair record. Contains a selected project task record value identifying the project task recorded for the repair.
entries.label: Project Task

entries.description: Identifies the employee recorded as completing the repair work. Stores an employee record reference that attributes the repair result to the technician or other employee responsible for completion.
entries.label: Completed By

entries.description: Records the result of repair work. Contains a list selection of complete, incomplete, or not applicable that summarizes the repair status separately from notes, images, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Outcome

entries.description: Stores free-form text describing the repair work and its recorded result. Captures service details that are not represented by the structured outcome, employee, asset, or related project, case, task, and project-task references.
entries.label: Notes

entries.description: Stores an image reference documenting the repair work. Associates visual evidence with the repair result while keeping the image distinct from written notes, structured outcome values, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Image

entries.description: Records uninstall work performed for a field service asset and links the outcome, notes, image, and completing employee to the related project, case, task, or project task.
entries.label: Field Service Uninstall

entries.description: Stores the field service asset associated with the field service uninstall record. Contains a selected asset record value identifying the asset recorded for the uninstall entry.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the netsuite project associated with an uninstall record. Stores a project record reference that relates the uninstall result to the broader project under which the field work was performed.
entries.label: Project

entries.description: Links the uninstall result to the NetSuite support case representing the customer service request. This relationship is distinct from the Project and Project Task fields on the uninstall result.
entries.label: Case

entries.description: Stores the crm task associated with the field service uninstall record. Contains a selected task record value identifying the task recorded for the uninstall entry.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Identifies the project task associated with an uninstall record. Stores a project task reference that relates the uninstall result to the project work assignment completed by the technician.
entries.label: Project Task

entries.description: Identifies the employee recorded as completing the uninstall work. Stores an employee record reference that attributes the uninstall result to the technician or other employee responsible for completion.
entries.label: Completed By

entries.description: Records the result of uninstall work. Contains a list selection of complete, incomplete, or not applicable that summarizes the uninstall status separately from notes, images, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Outcome

entries.description: Stores free-form text describing the uninstall work and its recorded result. Captures service details that are not represented by the structured outcome, employee, asset, or related project, case, task, and project-task references.
entries.label: Notes

entries.description: Stores an image reference documenting the uninstall work. Associates visual evidence with the uninstall result while keeping the image distinct from written notes, structured outcome values, and related work-record references.
entries.label: Image

entries.description: Records task-start and task-completion events for Field Service Management time tracking. Contains the activity date, time, time zone, coordinates, type, employee, and related task, supporting consistent task activity tracking.
entries.label: Field Service Activity

entries.description: Stores the date recorded for the field service activity. Contains a calendar date value associated with the task-start or task-completion activity entry and retained on the activity record.
entries.label: Date

entries.description: Stores the time recorded for the field service activity. Contains the confirmed time value associated with the task-start or task-completion activity entry and retained on the activity record.
entries.label: Time

entries.description: Stores the field service time zone associated with a recorded activity. Contains a time-zone record reference used with the separate date and time values to interpret when the task-start or task-completion event occurred.
entries.label: Timezone

entries.description: Stores the latitude recorded for the field service activity. Contains a geographic coordinate value representing the north-south position captured for the activity at the recorded time.
entries.label: Latitude

entries.description: Stores the longitude recorded for the field service activity. Contains a geographic coordinate value representing the east-west position captured for the activity at the recorded time.
entries.label: Longitude

entries.description: Stores the field service activity type assigned to a recorded activity. Contains the start task or complete task category that distinguishes whether the technician event records task commencement or completion.
entries.label: Type

entries.description: Stores the employee associated with a field service activity. Contains an employee record reference identifying the technician whose task-start or task-completion event was recorded for service-time tracking.
entries.label: Employee

entries.description: Stores the crm task associated with a field service activity. Contains a task record reference connecting the recorded employee, timestamp, activity type, and coordinates to the applicable field service work.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Represents anything serviced and tracked through Field Service Management. Stores customer, item, asset type, serial, location, coordinates, time zone, and source-transaction information used for service operations and history.
entries.label: Field Service Asset

entries.description: Classifies a field service asset by asset category. Contains a field service asset type record reference used to group the asset with similar serviceable assets.
entries.label: Type

entries.description: Stores the netsuite item associated with the field service asset. Contains a selected item record value recorded for the asset as its associated item record.
entries.label: Item

entries.description: Stores the field service asset's serial identifier as text. Used to distinguish the specific serviceable asset from other assets that may share the same item, customer, service location, or asset type.
entries.label: Serial

entries.description: Stores the primary customer associated with a field service asset. The relationship identifies the customer principally responsible for the asset and provides customer context for related support cases, tasks, projects, transactions, and service history.
entries.label: Customer

entries.description: Identifies the Field Service Management region assigned to an asset. Contains a region selection used to group the asset within the applicable service area, supporting customer asset tracking and service records.
entries.label: Region

entries.description: Stores the customer's structured address-book reference selected as the field service asset's service location. Distinguishes the customer address record from the asset's formatted address text, geographic coordinates, and time-zone values.
entries.label: Address Select

entries.description: Stores the latitude recorded for the field service asset. Contains a geographic coordinate value representing the asset location’s north-south position and retained on the asset record.
entries.label: Latitude

entries.description: Stores the longitude recorded for the field service asset. Contains a geographic coordinate value representing the asset location’s east-west position and retained on the asset record.
entries.label: Longitude

entries.description: Stores the field service time zone associated with the asset's service location. Contains a time-zone record reference used to interpret asset-related dates and times and support scheduling across geographic locations.
entries.label: Time Zone

entries.description: Stores the field service asset's formatted service address as text. Provides a readable location value that remains distinct from the structured customer address-book reference and the asset's latitude and longitude coordinates.
entries.label: Address

entries.description: Stores the item fulfillment that generated the field service asset during automatic creation. Contains a transaction reference and remains blank for manually created assets, preserving the source relationship without implying that every asset originates from fulfillment.
entries.label: Transaction

entries.description: Stores one or more additional customer record references associated with the field service asset. Represents alternate or shared customer relationships without replacing the separate primary customer value.
entries.label: Field Service Customers
notes: Eligible customers depend on workflow configuration; additional customers are not automatically accepted by every workflow.

entries.description: Represents an item and quantity recorded as consumed during work on a field service CRM task. Links the usage to its support case, CRM task, serviced asset, employee, inventory location, and the sales order created or updated for billing.
entries.label: Field Service Consumable

entries.description: Links a Field Service Consumable record to the support case for which the item was consumed. This relationship traces the source part usage to the customer service request and is distinct from project and transaction relationships.
entries.label: Case

entries.description: Links the Field Service Consumable to the CRM task where the item was used, connecting the recorded item and quantity to the specific field service work.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Identifies the field service asset associated with a consumable entry. Contains an asset record reference used to relate the consumed item to the serviced asset.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the employee who used the item recorded as a consumable. Contains an employee record reference that associates the consumption with the relevant field service employee.
entries.label: Employee

entries.description: Identifies the item represented by a consumable entry. Contains a netsuite item record reference used for the item consumed during field service work, supporting consumable tracking, billing, and inventory records.
entries.label: Item

entries.description: Stores how much of the consumable item was used during the related field service task. Contains a numeric quantity expressed in the item’s applicable unit of measure.
entries.label: Quantity

entries.description: Indicates whether a field service consumable is billable. Contains a checkbox value that controls whether the consumed item is billed; when cleared, the related sales order item receives a zero rate while the material usage remains recorded.
entries.label: Billable
notes: Nonbillable consumables can remain on sales orders at zero rate. Configured task billing and customer pricing can determine billability and price level.

entries.description: Identifies the price level applied to a consumable item on the sales order. Contains a price level record reference used when pricing the billed item.
entries.label: Price Level
notes: Configured task billing and customer pricing can replace the supplied price level during consumable validation.

entries.description: Identifies the sales order used to bill a consumable item. Stores a sales order transaction reference created or updated during consumable billing, supporting consumable billing and inventory records.
entries.label: Billing Transaction

entries.description: Identifies the inventory location associated with a consumable entry. Contains a netsuite location record reference used to record where the consumed item was sourced, supporting consumable tracking, billing, and inventory records.
entries.label: Location

entries.description: Records the serial identifier for a consumed item. Contains text used to identify the specific serialized item reported as consumed during field service work, supporting consumable tracking, billing, and inventory records.
entries.label: Serial
notes: Fulfillment expects a serial or lot inventory-number ID according to item type. Mobile display labels are separate; do not submit displayed serial text in place of the required ID.

entries.description: Identifies the inventory bin associated with a consumable entry. Contains an inventory bin record reference used to record where the consumed item was sourced, supporting consumable tracking, billing, and inventory records.
entries.label: Bin

entries.description: Records a job safety assessment for a field service task. Contains the related asset, task, outcome, notes, completing employee, and signature used to document the assessment.
entries.label: Field Service Job Safety

entries.description: Identifies the field service asset covered by a job safety assessment. Contains an asset record reference that relates the safety information to the relevant asset.
entries.label: Asset

entries.description: Identifies the task covered by a job safety assessment. Contains a task record reference that relates the safety information to the relevant field service work.
entries.label: Task

entries.description: Records the result of a job safety assessment. Contains a list selection of pass, fail, or not applicable for tracking the recorded safety outcome, supporting documented safety assessment records.
entries.label: Safety Check Outcome

entries.description: Stores written details about a job safety assessment. Contains free-form text for recording observations, conditions, explanations, or other safety information relevant to the assessment, supporting documented safety assessment records.
entries.label: Safety Check Notes

entries.description: Identifies the employee recorded as completing a job safety assessment. Contains an employee record reference used to preserve responsibility information for the completed assessment, supporting documented safety assessment records.
entries.label: Completed By

entries.description: Stores the signature captured for a job safety assessment. Contains signature data recorded with the assessment to document acknowledgement or completion, supporting documented safety assessment records.
entries.label: Signature
notes: When enabled on the form, signature handling uses visible rich-text fields matching the configured naming pattern, stores the image as an img data URL, and clears signatures on copy.

entries.description: Defines normal employee working days and hours for the Field Service Management schedule board when project management is not enabled. Stores a daily start time, working hours per day, and boolean values for each weekday.
entries.label: Field Service Work Calendar
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Records when a normal working day begins on a field service work calendar. Contains the configured start value used with the calendar's daily working hours.
entries.label: Start At
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Records the normal amount of working time scheduled per day. Contains the configured hours per day value used by the field service work calendar, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Hours Per Day
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether sunday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the sunday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Sunday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether monday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the monday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Monday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether tuesday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the tuesday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Tuesday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether wednesday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the wednesday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Wednesday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether thursday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the thursday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Thursday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether friday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the friday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Friday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Indicates whether saturday is included in a field service work calendar. Contains the saturday setting used to define the calendar's normal working week, supporting consistent field service scheduling.
entries.label: Saturday
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Defines languages selectable for customers and employees to localize mobile field labels and content.
entries.label: Field Service Language

entries.description: Defines the categories used to distinguish task-start activities from task-completion activities in fsm time tracking.
entries.label: Field Service Activity Type

entries.description: Defines categories for classifying field service assets. Contains selectable asset type records used to group serviceable assets by their assigned asset category, supporting consistent asset classification.
entries.label: Field Service Asset Type

entries.description: Defines categories for classifying Field Service Management cases. Contains selectable case type records used to determine applicable billing, notification, program, and mobile-content rules, supporting case classification and rule selection.
entries.label: Field Service Case Type

entries.description: Records a period when an employee is unavailable for Field Service Management scheduling. Contains an employee reference and start and end dates defining the non-working period.
entries.family: Field Service Employee Non Working Day
entries.label: Field Service Employee Non Working Day
notes: The scheduler displays overlapping periods as read-only, inclusive all-day events, from 00:00:00 on the first date through 23:59:59 on the last.

entries.description: Identifies the employee associated with a non-working period. Contains an employee record reference used to apply the recorded date range to the correct employee, supporting employee availability scheduling.
entries.family: Field Service Employee Non Working Day
entries.label: Employee
notes: The scheduler displays overlapping periods as read-only, inclusive all-day events, from 00:00:00 on the first date through 23:59:59 on the last.

entries.description: Records the first date of an employee's non-working period. Contains a calendar date used to establish when the recorded unavailability begins, supporting employee availability scheduling.
entries.family: Field Service Employee Non Working Day
entries.label: Start Date
notes: The scheduler displays overlapping periods as read-only, inclusive all-day events, from 00:00:00 on the first date through 23:59:59 on the last.

entries.description: Records the last date of an employee's non-working period. Contains a calendar date used to establish when the recorded unavailability ends, supporting employee availability scheduling.
entries.family: Field Service Employee Non Working Day
entries.label: End Date
notes: The scheduler displays overlapping periods as read-only, inclusive all-day events, from 00:00:00 on the first date through 23:59:59 on the last.

entries.description: Links a document uploaded for a field service task to the task and supplied upload location.
entries.label: Field Service File
notes: Upload creates File Cabinet content and a linked file record with task and supplied location. Deletion can also remove cabinet content when the separate delete option is enabled.

entries.description: Identifies the task associated with a field service file entry. Contains a task record reference used to relate the uploaded document to the relevant field service work.
entries.label: Task
notes: Upload creates File Cabinet content and a linked file record with task and supplied location. Deletion can also remove cabinet content when the separate delete option is enabled.

entries.description: Identifies the document associated with a field service file entry. Contains a file cabinet reference used to retrieve the document stored for the related task.
entries.label: Document
notes: Upload creates File Cabinet content and a linked file record with task and supplied location. Deletion can also remove cabinet content when the separate delete option is enabled.

entries.description: Stores location-coordinate data supplied with a field service file upload.
entries.label: Geolocation
notes: Upload creates File Cabinet content and a linked file record with task and supplied location. Deletion can also remove cabinet content when the separate delete option is enabled.

entries.description: Records a public holiday date associated with an fsm work calendar so schedulers can account for organization-wide non-working time.
entries.label: Field Service Non Working Day
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Records the public-holiday date represented by a field service non working day entry. Contains a calendar date excluded from normal scheduling for the associated work calendar.
entries.label: Date
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Identifies the field service work calendar associated with a public holiday. Contains a work calendar record reference used to apply the non-working date to the correct calendar.
entries.label: Work Calendar
notes: The scheduler uses start time, daily hours, weekday flags, and linked non-working dates for resource availability. Calendar display does not enforce every scheduling write.

entries.description: Defines categories for classifying Field Service Management projects. Contains selectable project type records used to determine applicable billing, notification, program, and mobile-content rules, supporting project classification and rule selection.
entries.label: Field Service Project Type

entries.description: Defines skill categories assigned to employees and field service tasks. Contains selectable skill records used as qualification information for resource matching and scheduling, supporting resource qualification and scheduling.
entries.label: Field Service Skill
notes: The case-task assignee selector matches all required skills. This UI filter does not establish universal assignment validation.

entries.description: Defines selectable outcomes for completed field service tasks. Contains outcome records used to describe the task result and indicate whether additional work is required, supporting task completion reporting.
entries.label: Field Service Task Outcome
notes: Outcome classifies the result; setting it alone must not be treated as task completion.

entries.description: Defines categories for classifying Field Service Management tasks. Contains selectable task type records used to determine applicable billing, notification, program, and mobile-content rules, supporting task classification and rule selection.
entries.label: Field Service Task Type

entries.description: Identifies the service item associated with a field service task type. Contains a service item record reference used to create billable time when service-time tracking is enabled.
entries.label: Service Time Item

entries.description: Links a CRM task or project task to the field service asset receiving service.
entries.label: Field Service Task Asset

entries.description: Stores the user-facing identifier assigned to a Field Service Management Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The value identifies the field service job independently of the record number and distinguishes task numbers from item, case, and project identifiers.
entries.label: Field Service Task Number

entries.description: Identifies the originating task from which the current field service task was created. Stores a task record reference that preserves the relationship between the source task and related field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Created From

entries.description: Stores text describing the work performed during a field service visit. The value records technician completion details for service history, operational follow-up, and customer or internal reporting.
entries.label: Field Service Actions Taken
notes: Mobile completion details are read-only for additional team users. The close-case control is hidden for project tasks; closure depends on configured status rules and processing.

entries.description: Stores the service-location address for a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The text value provides the location context used for scheduling, mapping, technician travel, and field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Address

entries.description: Selects the field service billing type assigned to a Customer Relationship Management task. The referenced billing type record classifies how the task participates in configured field service billing rules.
entries.label: Field Service Billing Type

entries.description: Links a standard NetSuite support case, identified by its Case Number, to the primary field service asset receiving service. The selected asset represents the main serviceable asset for the customer request and is distinct from project and project-task relationships.
entries.label: Field Service Case Asset

entries.description: Indicates whether completing a field service task or project task should close the related support case. The boolean value records the close-case choice associated with work completion.
entries.label: Field Service Close Case
notes: Mobile completion details are read-only for additional team users. The close-case control is hidden for project tasks; closure depends on configured status rules and processing.

entries.description: Stores text describing the customer's service need, reported problem, or work objective on a case. The value provides substantive job context for technicians, operations personnel, and service communications.
entries.label: Field Service Case Details

entries.description: Selects the field service case type assigned to a case. The referenced case type record classifies the service need for program behavior, operational filtering, and configured workflows.
entries.label: Field Service Case Type

entries.description: Links a task, project task, or support case to the customer receiving field service work. The selected customer provides consistent customer context across scheduling, assets, projects, transactions, service history, reporting, and relationship queries.
entries.label: Field Service Customer

entries.description: Stores the customer or signatory name entered during field service completion. The text value is captured separately from the customer record relationship and identifies the person associated with sign-off.
entries.label: Field Service Customer Name

entries.description: Stores the customer's captured signature for a Customer Relationship Management task, project task, or case. The rich-text value provides completion evidence and records customer acceptance associated with the field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Customer Signature
notes: When enabled on the form, signature handling uses visible rich-text fields matching the configured naming pattern, stores the image as an img data URL, and clears signatures on copy.

entries.description: Stores the local scheduled end date for field service work. The value combines with end time and Field Service Management time zone to establish the work's scheduled end timestamp.
entries.label: Field Service End Date
notes: Scheduled components are converted between FSM and session time zones according to task type, asset, and whether the FSM start date is populated. Confirm the connector operation applies the required conversion.

entries.description: Stores the local scheduled end time for field service work. The value combines with end date and Field Service Management time zone to establish the work's scheduled end timestamp.
entries.label: Field Service End Time
notes: Scheduled components are converted between FSM and session time zones according to task type, asset, and whether the FSM start date is populated. Confirm the connector operation applies the required conversion.

entries.description: Stores internal text about a Customer Relationship Management (crm) task for technicians and other authorized personnel. The value captures job-related context that is distinct from customer-facing service details and completion notes.
entries.label: Field Service Internal Note

entries.description: Stores the service location's latitude as a decimal geographic coordinate on a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The value supports mapping, travel planning, and location-based scheduling for field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Latitude

entries.description: Stores the service location's longitude as a decimal geographic coordinate on a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The value supports mapping, travel planning, and location-based scheduling for field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Longitude

entries.description: Links a Customer Relationship Management task or case to its field service recurrence definition. The selected recurrence record identifies the recurring series and supports series-level traceability, filtering, propagation, and deletion context.
entries.label: Field Service Recurrence
notes: Single-instance exceptions and series propagation are distinct; completed task instances are protected. Select the requested recurrence scope before changing records.

entries.description: Selects the employee who signed off the completed Customer Relationship Management task, project task, or case. The referenced employee record identifies the technician accountable for the recorded completion.
entries.label: Field Service Sign Off Technician

entries.description: Stores the local scheduled start date for field service work. The value combines with start time and Field Service Management time zone to establish the work's scheduled start timestamp.
entries.label: Field Service Start Date
notes: Scheduled components are converted between FSM and session time zones according to task type, asset, and whether the FSM start date is populated. Confirm the connector operation applies the required conversion.

entries.description: Stores the local scheduled start time for field service work. The value combines with start date and Field Service Management time zone to establish the work's scheduled start timestamp.
entries.label: Field Service Start Time
notes: Scheduled components are converted between FSM and session time zones according to task type, asset, and whether the FSM start date is populated. Confirm the connector operation applies the required conversion.

entries.description: Indicates whether the booking for a Customer Relationship Management task is confirmed. A checked value means the scheduled field service job is confirmed; this status is separate from Field Service Task Type and distinguishes confirmed work from tentative work.
entries.label: Field Service Task Confirmed Booking
notes: Booking confirmation is separate from task status and type. The scheduling UI allows editing only for NOTSTART work in an editable subsidiary.

entries.description: Stores the actual date and time when a technician completed a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The timestamp distinguishes actual completion from the work's scheduled end date and time.
entries.label: Field Service End
notes: Mobile CRM completion sets status immediately for task types without time tracking. Tracked types use activity, time, and status processing; actual start/end are separate from the schedule.

entries.description: Stores the actual date and time when the technician departed the service location for a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The timestamp is distinct from scheduled end and task completion.
entries.label: Field Service Off Site

entries.description: Stores the actual date and time when the technician arrived at the service location for a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The timestamp is distinct from scheduled start and task commencement.
entries.label: Field Service On Site

entries.description: Selects the field service task outcome recorded for a completed Customer Relationship Management task. The referenced outcome record classifies the service result for completion review, operational reporting, and follow-up.
entries.label: Field Service Task Outcome
notes: Outcome classifies the result; setting it alone must not be treated as task completion.

entries.description: Selects one or more field service skills required by a Customer Relationship Management task. The referenced skill records describe the capabilities needed for dispatcher filtering and technician matching.
entries.label: Field Service Skill
notes: The case-task assignee selector matches all required skills. This UI filter does not establish universal assignment validation.

entries.description: Stores the actual date and time when a technician began a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. The timestamp distinguishes actual commencement from the work's scheduled start date and time.
entries.label: Field Service Start
notes: Mobile CRM completion sets status immediately for task types without time tracking. Tracked types use activity, time, and status processing; actual start/end are separate from the schedule.

entries.description: Selects additional employees assigned to a Customer Relationship Management task, separate from the primary assigned employee. The referenced employee records represent the task team for scheduling and resource visibility.
entries.label: Field Service Team
notes: FSM task validation removes the primary assignee from the additional team when it runs; other write paths may leave the same employee in both. Scheduler visibility combines both; project-task assignment uses a separate structure.

entries.description: Classifies the kind of field service work assigned to a Customer Relationship Management task or project task. This value does not indicate whether the booking is confirmed; confirmation is stored separately in Field Service Task Confirmed Booking.
entries.label: Field Service Task Type

entries.description: Stores the technician's captured signature for a Customer Relationship Management task, project task, or case. The rich-text value provides completion evidence and identifies technician acceptance associated with the field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Technician Signature
notes: When enabled on the form, signature handling uses visible rich-text fields matching the configured naming pattern, stores the image as an img data URL, and clears signatures on copy.

entries.description: Selects the Field Service Management time zone associated with a Customer Relationship Management task, project task, or case. The referenced value provides local-time context for interpreting scheduled date and time components.
entries.label: Field Service Time Zone
notes: Scheduled components are converted between FSM and session time zones according to task type, asset, and whether the FSM start date is populated. Confirm the connector operation applies the required conversion.

entries.description: Stores the case-level currency total for billable expense report lines related to the field service work that have not yet been billed. The value supports invoicing and operational follow-up.
entries.label: Field Service Unbilled Expenses
notes: When Expense Reports is enabled, the total sums billable case expense lines without an applying transaction, excluding tax.

entries.description: Stores the case-level currency total for billable sales order lines related to the field service work that have not yet been billed. The value excludes consumables not yet placed on a sales order.
entries.label: Field Service Unbilled Sales
notes: The total sums related sales-order amountunbilled values. Consumables not yet processed into sales orders are excluded.

entries.description: Stores the case-level currency total for qualifying billable time associated with the case or its related tasks. Check individual time approval and invoicing state separately.
entries.label: Field Service Unbilled Time
notes: The total selects direct case time or related task time with search status T, positive duration, and billable T, then sums rate multiplied by duration. Check approval and invoicing state separately.

entries.description: Read-only, nonstored formula adding the case-level unbilled expense, time, and sales totals.
entries.label: Field Service Unbilled Total

entries.description: Stores the field service language selected for a customer or employee. The referenced language record supports localized field labels and content during mobile field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Language

entries.description: Links a project to its primary field service asset. The selected asset record identifies the main serviceable asset used for program eligibility, recurring-work generation, service traceability, filtering, and reporting.
entries.label: Field Service Asset

entries.description: Links a Field Service Management project to the customer receiving the service. The selected customer record supports program configuration and connects the project with its related assets, cases, tasks, and service history.
entries.label: Field Service Customer

entries.description: Stores the employee resource's latitude as a decimal geographic coordinate. Field Service Management uses the value with longitude to represent the technician's position for mapping and dispatch decisions.
entries.label: Field Service Latitude

entries.description: Selects the employee or vendor resource's local inventory location. The referenced location record supports consumable inventory and identifies originating or receiving locations in supported transfer-order workflows.
entries.label: Field Service Employee Location

entries.description: Stores the employee resource's longitude as a decimal geographic coordinate. Field Service Management uses the value with latitude to represent the technician's position for mapping and dispatch decisions.
entries.label: Field Service Longitude

entries.description: Indicates whether an employee has mobile field service access. The boolean value records mobile-access eligibility for account administration, access management, license tracking, and reporting purposes.
entries.label: Field Service Mobile User

entries.description: Stores the generation horizon in days for a Field Service Management project with no end date.
entries.label: Field Service Program Create Until
notes: When the project has no end date, generation ends this many days after the current date in the resolved project time zone.

entries.description: Selects the field service project type assigned to a Field Service Management project. The referenced type classifies the project and helps determine whether its configuration supports program-generated work.
entries.label: Field Service Project Type

entries.description: Selects the service region assigned to an employee resource. The referenced region record supports resource filtering and helps schedulers identify technicians associated with a geographic or operational area.
entries.label: Field Service Region

entries.description: Selects one or more field service skills assigned to an employee, vendor, or generic resource. The values describe resource capabilities used for scheduling, resource filtering, and suitable-assignee selection.
entries.label: Field Service Skill
notes: The case-task assignee selector matches all required skills. This UI filter does not establish universal assignment validation.

entries.description: Stores the program scheduling start date for a Field Service Management project. When populated, the date replaces the project start date as the anchor for calculating the first generated case pattern.
entries.label: Field Service Start Date
notes: This date replaces the recurrence-pattern anchor; the native project start remains a separate generation boundary.

entries.description: Selects the Field Service Management time zone associated with a project. The referenced value supplies the scheduling context used by program-generated projects, cases, and tasks for asset-related work.
entries.label: Field Service Time Zone

entries.description: Selects the employee's default warehouse for mobile inventory transfers. The referenced location record provides the default source for ordered parts and destination for returned parts.
entries.label: Field Service Employee Warehouse

entries.description: Selects the field service work calendar assigned to an employee resource. The referenced calendar represents working availability for scheduling, workload planning, and capacity decisions across field operations.
entries.label: Field Service Work Calendar

entries.description: Links a project to multiple field service assets for service planning, filtering, and configured program generation.
entries.label: Field Service Assets
notes: Propagation of multiple assets to generated work depends on the applicable program configuration.

entries.description: Links a transaction to the field service asset associated with the work. The relationship identifies the transaction's overall asset, while line-level asset fields can identify different assets for individual transaction lines.
entries.label: Field Service Asset

entries.description: Links a transaction to the customer associated with the field service work. The relationship preserves the service customer when the transaction's standard entity represents a project or another party.
entries.label: Field Service Customer

entries.description: Stores the customer's captured signature for a field service sales transaction or quote. The rich-text value records customer confirmation or acceptance associated with the transaction.
entries.label: Field Service Customer Signature
notes: When enabled on the form, signature handling uses visible rich-text fields matching the configured naming pattern, stores the image as an img data URL, and clears signatures on copy.

entries.description: Links a transaction to the project task associated with the field service work. The relationship connects sales, expenses, purchasing, or inventory movements to work managed within a project.
entries.label: Field Service Project Task

entries.description: Links a transaction to the Customer Relationship Management task representing the technician's field service visit or work assignment. The relationship connects transaction activity to the scheduled field service work.
entries.label: Field Service Task

entries.description: Links a transaction to the support case for the field service work. This direct relationship identifies the case associated with the transaction and is distinct from customer, project, and asset relationships.
entries.label: Field Service Case

entries.description: Links a transaction line to the field service asset receiving the work, attributing the line’s parts, expenses, time, or inventory activity to that asset.
entries.label: Field Service Asset (trans)

entries.description: Links a transaction line to the support case for the field service work. This direct relationship identifies the case associated with the line and is distinct from customer, project, and asset relationships.
entries.label: Field Service Case (trans)

entries.description: Links a sales order or item fulfillment line to its related Field Service Consumable, tracing the billed or fulfilled item and quantity back to the source CRM task, support case, asset, and employee.
entries.label: Field Service Consumable

entries.description: Stores the time of day when a field service time entry ended. The value distinguishes the labor end time from the entry's start time and total recorded duration.
entries.label: Field Service End Time

entries.description: Links a transaction line to the project task associated with the field service work. The relationship attributes line-level parts, expenses, time, or inventory activity to work managed within a project.
entries.label: Field Service Project Task (trans)

entries.description: Stores the time of day when a field service time entry began. The value distinguishes the labor start time from the entry's end time and total recorded duration.
entries.label: Field Service Start Time

entries.description: Links a transaction line to the Customer Relationship Management task representing the technician's field service visit or work assignment. The relationship connects line-level time, parts, expenses, or inventory activity to the scheduled work.
entries.label: Field Service Task (trans)

entries.description: Stores the monetary labor cost associated with a field service time entry. The value supports job-cost review, profitability analysis, and reconciliation of approved field service time.
entries.label: Field Service Time Cost

entries.description: Indicates whether an item is designated for field service asset workflows. The boolean value distinguishes items configured for asset creation and processing without identifying a specific field service asset.
entries.label: Field Service Asset
notes: Fulfillment uses flagged items to build asset candidates by line quantity, including serialized inventory labels when available. Verify the resulting assets after processing.

entries.description: Stores the warranty duration in months for configured warranty project generation when an asset is created from the item.
entries.label: Field Service Project Duration
notes: With the default warranty rules, a configured project type triggers warranty project scheduling on asset creation. The end is the current date/time in the resolved time zone plus the duration in months, minus one day. Overrides can change this behavior.

entries.description: Selects the project type used by configured warranty project generation when an asset is created from the item.
entries.label: Field Service Project Type
notes: With the default warranty rules, a configured project type triggers warranty project scheduling on asset creation. The end is the current date/time in the resolved time zone plus the duration in months, minus one day. Overrides can change this behavior.

entries.description: Indicates whether an item is enabled for mobile field service ordering. The boolean value controls whether field personnel can select the item in supported quotation and ordering workflows.
entries.label: Field Service Show On Mobile

entries.description: The general labour cost for the employee.
entries.label: Field Service Labour Cost
Field Service Expense Category Show On Mobile

entries.description: Holds the values that are used to make instances.
entries.label: Field Values
